items.source: Also automatically sets the defaultHeartbeat property to "10000,10000" if it is currently set to "0,0".
items.translation: 同时也自动将 defaultHeartbeat 属性设置为"10000,10000"，如果当前该属性被设置为"0,0"。

items.source: By default this is set to 64 * 1024 (64K).
items.translation: 默认情况下，该值设置为 64 * 1024（64K）。

items.source: By default this is not set in which case each STOMP message are not split.
items.translation: 默认情况下，此选项未设置，此时每个 STOMP 消息不会被拆分。

items.source:
By default this is Integer.MAX_VALUE meaning that the WebSocket client
is started as late as possible and stopped as soon as possible.
items.translation: 默认情况下，该值为 `Integer.MAX_VALUE`，这意味着 WebSocket 客户端将在尽可能晚的时间启动，并在尽可能早的时间停止。

items.source: Class constructor. Sets StompClientSupport.setDefaultHeartbeat(long[]) to "0,0" but will reset it back to the preferred "10000,10000" when a setTaskScheduler(TaskScheduler) is configured.
items.translation: 类构造函数。将 StompClientSupport.setDefaultHeartbeat(long[]) 设置为 "0,0"，但在配置了 setTaskScheduler(TaskScheduler) 时，会将其重置回首选的 "10000,10000"。

items.source: In the case of a container, this will return true only if all components that apply are currently running.
items.translation: 对于容器而言，仅当所有适用的组件当前都在运行时，此方法才返回 `true`。

items.source: Note: Some transports have built-in support to work with heartbeats and therefore do not require a TaskScheduler. Receipts however, if needed, do require a TaskScheduler to be configured.
items.translation: 注意： 某些传输方式内置了对心跳的支持，因此不需要配置 TaskScheduler。然而，如果需要收据，则必须配置 TaskScheduler。

items.source: Note that this stop notification is not guaranteed to come before destruction: On regular shutdown, Lifecycle beans will first receive a stop notification before the general destruction callbacks are being propagated; however, on hot refresh during a context's lifetime or on aborted refresh attempts, a given bean's destroy method will be called without any consideration of stop signals upfront.
items.translation: 请注意，此停止通知并不保证在销毁之前发出： 在常规关闭过程中，Lifecycle 圈会先接收停止通知，然后再传播通用的销毁回调；然而，在上下文生命周期期间的热刷新或中止的刷新尝试中，给定 bean 的销毁方法将在不考虑任何预先停止信号的情况下被调用。

items.source: By default, this is not set.
items.translation: 默认情况下，此项未设置。

items.source: Default is "true".
items.translation: 默认值为"true"。

items.source: Should not throw an exception if the component is already running.
items.translation: 如果组件已经在运行，则不应抛出异常。

items.source:
In the case of a container, this will propagate a hard start signal to all
components that apply, even to non-auto-startup components.
items.translation: 对于容器而言，这将向所有适用的组件传播硬启动信号，即使包括非自动启动的组件。

items.source: Should not throw an exception if the component is not running (not started yet).
items.translation: 如果组件尚未运行（尚未启动），则不应抛出异常。

items.source:
In the case of a container, this will propagate the stop signal to all components
that apply.
items.translation: 对于容器，这将向所有适用的组件传播停止信号。
